Nek'zali the Soulcoiler: [위치] If you are the Possession Barrage target, use Divine Steed for 100% movement speed and run far from the boss.
[제어] Stun a Restless Amani with its shield still up for 6 sec with Hammer of Justice to slow it down (Icy Veins); Method says shielded Amani can't be stopped.
[생존기] Under Uncoiled Rage, taunts do not work and all damage rises by 500%, so reduce damage taken by 50% with Guardian of Ancient Kings.

Entombed Sentinels: [탱버] Empowering Slam and Bloodvenom Injection deal 2.5 million physical damage, so have Shield of the Righteous up for armor when they are cast.
[교대] When the intermission ends, take the boss with Hand of Reckoning and go to the same side.

Vashnik the Malignant: [탱버] Time Ardent Defender (30% damage reduction) for the Dripping Fangs hit, then swap.
[제어] Burning Venom can be held with Hammer of Justice or Blinding Light until Hardened Venom.

The Lost Explorers: [교대] On the Shredding Shards swap, take Scrollsage Iku with Hand of Reckoning.
[차단] Interrupt Icebound Flames with Rebuke or Avenger's Shield.
[탱버] Use Ardent Defender or Guardian of Ancient Kings when Steady Strikes stacks are high.

Sszorak: [교대] During the Apex Predator cast, swap targets with Hand of Reckoning so each tank takes one of Ravage and Mutilate.
[탱버] When taking Ravage, reduce damage taken by 50% with Guardian of Ancient Kings.
[생존기] When the other tank takes Ravage, you can reduce their damage taken by 30% with Blessing of Sacrifice.

The Twin Fangs: [탱버] Reduce damage taken by 30% with Ardent Defender during the 5 sec Caustic Deluge.
[위치] After being knocked back by Stone Breaker, use Divine Steed to quickly step on the stomp spots in order.
@m [탱버] Fill the Blood Torrent healing absorb with Word of Glory or Lay on Hands.

The Coiled Altar: [교대] After taking Sever, swap for the next Sever with Hand of Reckoning and use Guardian of Ancient Kings when you take it.
[차단] Once Veil of Twilight breaks, interrupt Eternal Nightfall with Rebuke.
@hm [차단] Interrupt Spiteful Soulcoiler's Wail of Terror with Rebuke or Avenger's Shield.

Ula'tek: [교대] On the Caustic Waves cast, swap Ula'tek and Gore Rattle with Hand of Reckoning.
[위치] If Mother's Wrath knocks you back, get back in range right away with Divine Steed, and during the Hobbled slow use Blessing of Freedom to become immune to movement impairing effects.
[해제] Clear the Acidic Burst poison from Blightscale Viper with Cleanse Toxins.

Nymrissa Wavecaller: [탱버] Water Jet damage stacks up by 20% with every hit, so use Ardent Defender or Guardian of Ancient Kings on the later Water Jets.
[제어] Stun a Bubblefin Shorerunner heading for the bubble for 6 sec with Hammer of Justice.

Imperator Averzian: [교대] After the first Umbral Collapse, take the boss with Hand of Reckoning and take the second Umbral Collapse.
[탱버] When Gnashing Void DoTs from Voidmaws charging in under Weakened stack up, reduce damage taken by 30% with Ardent Defender.
[차단] Interrupt the intermission Pitch Bulwark with Rebuke or Avenger's Shield.

Vorasius: [탱버] When taking the second big claw impact with Smashed stacked, reduce damage taken by 50% with Guardian of Ancient Kings.
[위치] If a Blistercreep latches onto you, use Divine Steed for 100% movement speed and go to your side's Void Crystal wall.
[위치] Put Blessing of Freedom on a Blistercreep target with stacked Creep Spit slows so they get movement impairment immunity and reach the wall.

Fallen-King Salhadaar: [탱버] Shattering Twilight is heavy Shadow damage, so pop Guardian of Ancient Kings by the wall and take it.
[교대] When Destabilizing Strikes stacks build up, take the boss with Hand of Reckoning and drag it away from the Concentrated Void orbs.
[차단] Interrupt Shadow Fracture from the nearest Fractured Image with Rebuke or Avenger's Shield, or stun it with Hammer of Justice.

Vaelgor & Ezzorak: [탱버] Ezzorak's Rakfang is heavy physical damage, so have Shield of the Righteous up for armor when it is cast and use Ardent Defender when the empowerment has stacked.
[생존기] When the other tank takes an empowered Rakfang, you can reduce their damage taken by 30% with Blessing of Sacrifice.
[우선 처치] Pick up the intermission Manifestation of Midnight with Hand of Reckoning and pull it away from the raid.

Lightblinded Vanguard: [교대] Swap with Hand of Reckoning right after Commander Venel Lightblood's Judgment to avoid the amplified Final Verdict damage.
[탱버] While tanking all three bosses together, reduce damage taken by 30% with Ardent Defender when Final Verdict or Exorcism overlap.
[차단] Once Sacred Shield breaks, interrupt War Chaplain Senn's Blinding Light with Rebuke or Avenger's Shield.

Crown of the Cosmos: [위치] If Dark Hand knocks you back, get right back into the sentinel's melee range with Divine Steed.
@nh [교대] When Rift Slash stacks reduce your stats, swap with Hand of Reckoning after the Undying Voidspawn is handled.
@nh [생존기] Gravity Collapse from breaking Aspect of the End increases physical damage taken by 300%, so pop Guardian of Ancient Kings.

Chimaerus the Undreamt God: [탱버] The Alndust Upheaval target takes heavy physical damage, so pop Ardent Defender and take it with your group.
[탱버] When Colossal Horror's Colossal Strikes ramp up on the lower floor, reduce damage taken by 50% with Guardian of Ancient Kings.
[차단] On the lower floor, interrupt Haunting Essence's Fearsome Cry first with Rebuke or Avenger's Shield.

Belo'ren, Child of Al'ar: [교대] When the opposite-color Light Edict or Void Edict comes, the matching-color tank takes the boss with Hand of Reckoning during the cast and takes it.
[탱버] Light Edict and Void Edict hit hard, so pop Ardent Defender or Guardian of Ancient Kings before taking them.
[차단] Interrupt Light Eruption or Void Eruption from embers matching your feather color with Rebuke or Avenger's Shield.

Midnight Falls: [교대] Swap with Hand of Reckoning after the 5 Heaven's Lance stabs end, and pop Ardent Defender when you take the stabs.
@nh [차단] Remove Safeguard stacks on a Safeguard Prism matrix with Rebuke and Avenger's Shield interrupts and Hammer of Justice stuns.
@m [차단] Interrupt Terminate from your assigned Termination Prism matrix with Rebuke.

Rotmire: [교대] Swap with Hand of Reckoning after taking Putrid Fist, and when you take it, have Shield of the Righteous up for armor and pop Guardian of Ancient Kings.
@hm [차단] Interrupt Poison Burst from the Sporecaps near the boss with Rebuke or Avenger's Shield.
@hm [해제] Clear a Poison Burst poison DoT that slips past interrupts with Cleanse Toxins.

633.m: Talent · 40 yd range · Instant · 10 min cooldown
633.d:
Heals a friendly target for an amount equal to 100% your maximum health.

Cannot be used on a target with Forbearance. Causes Forbearance for 30 sec.

853.m: 0.7% of base mana · 10 yd range · Instant · 45 sec cooldown

1044.m: Talent · 1.4% of base mana · 40 yd range · Instant · 25 sec cooldown · 1 Charge
1044.d: Blesses a party or raid member, granting immunity to movement impairing effects [Unbound Freedom: and increasing movement speed by 30%]for 8 sec.

31850.d:
Reduces all damage you take by 30% for 12 sec.

While Ardent Defender is active, the next attack that would otherwise kill you will instead bring you to 20% of your maximum health.

31935.m: Talent · 30 yd range · Instant · 15 sec cooldown
31935.d:
Hurls your shield at an enemy target, dealing (200% of Attack Power) Holy damage, interrupting and silencing the non-Player target for 3 sec, and then jumping to 2 additional nearby enemies.

Shields you for 8 sec, absorbing 75% as much damage as it dealt.

Deals ((12% of Attack Power)) additional damage to all enemies within 5 yds of each target hit.

53600.m: 3 to 5 Holy Power · Melee Range · Instant · 1 sec cooldown
53600.d:
Slams enemies in front of you with your shield, causing (95% of Attack Power) Holy damage, and increasing your Armor by (192 * Strength / 100) for 4.5 sec.

Armor granted by Shield of the Righteous is increased by up to 72%, based on your missing health.

62124.m: 0.6% of base mana · 30 yd range · Instant · 8 sec cooldown · 1 Charge
62124.d: Commands the attention of an enemy target, forcing them to attack you and increasing the threat you generate against them by 800% for 6 sec.

85673.m: 3 Holy Power / 15% of base mana · 40 yd range · Instant
85673.d:
Calls down the Light to heal a friendly target for (415.8% of Spell Power).

Protection:

86659.m: Talent · 30 yd range · Instant · 3 min cooldown · 1 Charge
86659.d: Empowers you with the spirit of ancient kings, reducing all damage you take by 50% for 8 sec.

96231.m: Talent · Melee Range · Instant · 15 sec cooldown
96231.d: Interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.

115750.m: Talent · 1.2% of base mana · Instant · 1.5 min cooldown
115750.d: Emits dazzling light in all directions, blinding enemies within 10 yds, causing them to wander disoriented for 6 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.

190784.d: Leap atop your Charger for 3 sec, increasing movement speed by 100%. Usable while indoors or in combat.

213644.m: Talent · 10% of base mana · 40 yd range · Instant · 8 sec cooldown · 1 Charge
213644.d: Cleanses a friendly target, removing all Poison and Disease effects.

633.m: 특성 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 10 분 재사용 대기시간
633.d:
자신의 최대 생명력의 100%만큼 아군 대상의 생명력을 회복시킵니다.

참을성 상태인 대상에게는 사용할 수 없습니다. 대상은 이후 30초 동안 참을성 상태가 됩니다.

853.m: 0.7% (기본 마나 중) · 10 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 45 초 재사용 대기시간

1044.m: 특성 · 1.4% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 25 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
1044.d: 대상 파티원 또는 공격대원에게 축복을 내려, 8초 동안 이동 방해 효과에 면역이 되도록 [해방된 자유: 하고, 이동 속도를 30%만큼 증가시킵니다 / 합니다].

31850.d:
12초 동안 자신이 받는 모든 피해를 30%만큼 감소시킵니다.

헌신적인 수호자가 활성화되어 있는 동안 죽음에 이르는 피해를 입으면, 죽지 않고 남은 생명력이 최대 생명력의 20%로 변경됩니다.

31935.m: 특성 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 15 초 재사용 대기시간
31935.d:
적에게 방패를 날려 (전투력의 200%)의 신성 피해를 입힙니다. 대상이 플레이어가 아니라면 주문 시전을 차단하고 3초 동안 침묵시킵니다. 또한, 주위 적 2명을 연쇄적으로 가격합니다.

Shields you for 8 sec, absorbing 75% as much damage as it dealt.

Deals ((전투력의 12%)) additional damage to all enemies within 5 yds of each target hit.

53600.m: 신성한 힘 3의 5개 · 근접 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1 초 재사용 대기시간
53600.d:
전방의 적을 방패로 가격하여 (전투력의 95%)의 신성 피해를 입힙니다. 4.5초 동안 방어도가 (160 * 힘 / 100)만큼 증가합니다.

Armor granted by Shield of the Righteous is increased by up to 72%, based on your missing health.

62124.m: 0.6% (기본 마나 중) · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 8 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
62124.d: 적을 호령하여 자신에게 주의를 돌리게 해, 강제로 자신을 공격하게 합니다. 또한 6초 동안 대상을 향해 생성되는 위협 수준이 800%만큼 증가합니다.

85673.m: 신성한 힘 3개 / 15% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시
85673.d:
아군 대상에게 빛을 내려 (주문력의 415.8%)만큼 생명력을 회복시킵니다.

Protection:

86659.m: 특성 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 3 분 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
86659.d: 고대 왕의 영혼으로 자신을 강화화여, 8초 동안 받는 모든 피해가 50%만큼 감소합니다.

96231.m: 특성 · 근접 사정거리 · 즉시 · 15 초 재사용 대기시간
96231.d: 주문 시전을 차단하고, 대상이 5초 동안 같은 계열의 주문을 시전하는 것을 방해합니다.

115750.m: 특성 · 1.2% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 1.5 분 재사용 대기시간
115750.d: 휘황찬란한 빛을 사방으로 내뿜어 10미터 내의 적들의 눈을 멀게 하고, 6초 동안 방향 감각을 상실하여 방황하게 만듭니다. 피해를 받으면 효과가 해제될 수 있습니다.

190784.m: 특성 · 즉시 · 45 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
190784.d: 군마에 올라타 3초 동안 이동 속도가 100%만큼 증가합니다. 실내 또는 전투 중에도 사용할 수 있습니다.

213644.m: 특성 · 10% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 8 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
213644.d: 아군 대상을 정화하여 모든 독과 질병 효과를 제거합니다.

note: There is no spec-specific source for each raid boss, so these are general principles written by matching ability tooltips to boss mechanics.

notes: 탱버·교대 줄은 digest 역할 tank 항목(Empowering Slam·Dripping Fangs·Shredding Shards·Steady Strikes·Apex Predator·Caustic Deluge·Stone Breaker·Sever·Caustic Waves·Water Jet)과 core 보스 툴팁의 피해 계열(물리/자연/암흑/냉기)을 기술 툴팁 효과와 짝지었다.
면역으로 기믹을 무시한다는 서술은 넣지 않았다(기절·공포·밀쳐내기 면역 기술 포함). 영웅 특성 전용 기술은 쓰지 않았다.
쐐기 파일 tips에는 있으나 spells가 비어 있던 기술 12개와 Hand of Reckoning 1개 툴팁을 새로 받아 spells/spellsKo에 넣었다.
1시즌: Hand of Reckoning 툴팁은 이번 시즌 레이드 전문화 파일에서 그대로 옮겼다.
1시즌: Blessing of Spellwarding 같은 면역기로 기믹을 무시한다는 서술은 넣지 않았다. 영웅 특성 전용 기술은 쓰지 않았다.
